newsitem.title: SPAIN: Endesa surges, dealers see Chile deal announcement.
newsitem.headline: Endesa surges, dealers see Chile deal announcement.

text.p: Shares in Spanish utility Endesa were up sharply on Friday on speculation that the likely announcement from this afternoon's Endesa-Sepi press conference would be a deal with Chilean energy group Enersis, dealers said.
Enersis controls Chile's largest power generator Endesa, and is linked to the Chispas group of investment companies.

A statement from Spanish state holding company Sepi earlier said a conference at 1515 GMT today had been called to announce "an important financial operation," which fuelled the rumours, dealers said.
"Just the announcement in itself is prompting buying," said one dealer at a Spanish bank.
Endesa this week confirmed it was in talks with Chispas' shareholders. Market sources said Endesa may announce a purchase of a stake.
At 1030 GMT, Endesa was up 70 pesetas, 2.19 percent, to 3,270 pesetas while the Ibex-35 blue chip index was down 0.2 percnt to 6,809.59.
